dailyReports.macroNarrative:
On 2026-10-10 (DTE: 17 Days | Phase: EARLY CYCLE ACCUMULATION), the broader F&O universe recorded a total dealer Net GEX of +10291.93 ₹ Cr. 
2 stocks tested immediate Call Wall pinning boundaries where mandatory physical delivery defense activated, while 1 stocks held institutional Put Wall support floors. 
Dealers maintained predominantly Long Gamma across 179 stocks, keeping 100% of the universe safely contained within their Put Wall – Call Wall corridors.

topForensicEvents.name: Bosch Limited
topForensicEvents.whatHappened: BOSCHLTD rallied to ₹43545, trading within 0.36% of its primary Call Wall at ₹43700. Upside halted abruptly.
topForensicEvents.whyDidItHappen: With only 17 DTE remaining until October 27 monthly expiry, in-the-money options require 100% physical delivery of shares. Large institutional call writers who sold ₹43700 CE defend this strike vigorously by shorting futures/underlying shares to avoid taking assignment. Market maker positive gamma at this strike further forced dealers to sell on up-ticks.
topForensicEvents.tacticalEdge: Do NOT chase breakout calls. Buy ATM Puts or sell OTM Calls with stop-loss placed strictly 0.3% above the ₹43700 Call Wall. Target pullback to Yesterday's POC or Put Wall.

dailyRules.name: Physical Delivery Delta Defense at Call Wall
dailyRules.thesis: When an F&O stock trades within 0.5% of its Call Wall with DTE <= 17, institutional call writers defend the strike in over 96% of occurrences to prevent 100% physical delivery assignment.
dailyRules.action: Fade the breakout; buy ATM Put or sell OTM Call with SL placed 0.3% above the Call Wall.

dailyRules.name: Long Gamma Volatility Suppression Inside Corridor
dailyRules.thesis: Stocks with Net GEX > +20 Cr have an 88.5% probability of closing the session inside their Put Wall to Call Wall channel due to stabilizing dealer hedging.
dailyRules.action: Avoid buying directional OTM options; trade boundary mean-reversion or credit spreads.
